text: Healthy living means taking care of both your body and mind. A balanced diet with fruits, vegetables, and whole grains gives you energy and supports your immune system. Regular exercise, like walking or cycling for 30 minutes a day, strengthens your heart and reduces stress. Don't forget sleep—aiming for seven to nine hours each night helps your brain recharge and improves concentration. Mental health is equally important; try relaxation techniques or hobbies to stay calm. Finally, maintain a work-life balance by setting boundaries, taking breaks, and spending time with loved ones. Small, consistent habits in these areas lead to a healthier, happier life.
